address:
The Chicago Clay Co-Op
4636 N. Ravenswood Ave
Unit 107
Chicago, IL 60640
description: The Chicago Clay Co-Op is located in unit 107 of the BullDog Lock Co. building.\n\nWe are available to the public by appointment only, but feel free to ring our buzzer (107) if you’re in the neighborhood!

transit: 0.4 miles from the 81 Bus at Lawrence & Ashland
biking: There are bike racks immediately in front of the building
There is a Divvy Dock at Lawrence & Ravenswood
driving: There is free parking west of Wolcott on Wilson
Both sides of Ravenswood are permit parking only from 10-3pm between Wilson and Lawrence — we have one day passes available
The lot behind the building is $12 per day

yes: Water bottle or drinks. We have a fridge and filtered water here in case you forget :)
Clothes that you don’t mind getting dirty
An apron and some old dish towels
Tools if you have them (we will provide any necessary tools)
tools: We provide workshop and class participants with any necessary tools, However if you’d like to purchase your own, we recommend the Mudtools Essentails Starter kit.
